prompt: In a vibrant anime style illustration, a mountain campsite nestles among towering pine trees under a clear blue sky. On the left side of the frame, a woman with short pink hair sits cross-legged on a green sleeping bag, holding a steaming mug of cocoa. Next to her, a small orange cat curls up tightly, its tail wrapped around its nose. In the center foreground, a man in a red scarf stands tall, pointing enthusiastically toward the distant snow-capped peak. Beside him, a brown dog with floppy ears looks up at his face, tongue lolling out happily. To the right, a girl with long braids kneels beside a crackling campfire, carefully handing a marshmallow stick to a boy wearing round glasses who reaches out to take it. Behind them, a large blue tent is pitched firmly on the grass, its flap open to reveal a glimpse of interior pillows. A wooden picnic table sits near the tent, cluttered with a yellow lantern and a stack of firewood. Perched on top of the firewood stack is a black crow, watching the scene with keen interest. Further back, an elderly man with a white beard leans against a tree trunk, observing the group with a gentle smile. The final figure, a teenager in a hoodie, lies on their stomach on a blanket near the fire, sketching in a notebook. There is no modern technology visible in the scene. There is no rain or stormy weather depicted.
